z_stack_rule: Layered PNG scene plate plus editable scientific interpretation.
global_overlay_rules: Use PNG proof scenes as Z2 evidence plates, not as all-in-one final slides.
Rebuild headline, bridge line, source, caveat, and any presenter text as editable objects.
Keep source and caveat text visible but subordinate.
Do not put table-like panels inside figure cards; tables move to backup or manuscript tables.
Avoid adding organoid/OSD-120 extension visuals before slide 20.

slide_specific.rule: Build original opening visuals; do not use result thumbnails as decorative background.
Visible slide can be compressed, but speaker notes must carry task-unit and train-only guard definitions.
Use feature-layer bridge to define gene and pathway views before score surfaces.
Use early result scenes to establish tissue, pathway, and model-comparison logic before hardening.
Use core-result caption pack and keep each slide's claim boundary line intact.
